title: Pashupatinath Temple
visualBrief: The specific principal Pashupatinath pagoda exterior: square stone platform, four silver-covered doors in a dark timber lower shrine, two independently mapped gold hipped roofs, the upper timber storey and a tall central gold pinnacle. Courtyard buildings, separate pavilions, river ghats and eastern stone shrines remain independent native context; the broader precinct is not one temple footprint.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Standard PMTiles building35185285259147 is also the named Pashupatinath Temple POI. Its four-point platform and four independently mapped roof/body/finial parts identify the principal shrine. Preserve raw east/south coordinates and the square grid axis at37.66 degrees south of east. Four door faces are treated symmetrically; the separate eastern precinct gate is not confused with the main shrine.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Normal map parts give lower roof9–11.5m, upper storey14.5m and upper roof14.5–19m. The ordinary article architecture paragraph gives nominal23.07m base-to-pinnacle height. The upper roof tag includes the lower pinnacle base: use a picture-guided17.5m roof crest and the23.07m final tip. Preserve the photographed broad roof pitches and relative widths; exact carved timber, door relief and pinnacle ornaments are simplified estimates. The small mapped central part has inconsistent13–16m tags and is used only as a horizontal center control.
